correctness.rationale: The predicate is equivalent to omissions of 2,F-2,F; forbidden sum complements form a path of 2(k-2) vertices and bound nongaps by k-1. Every maximum independent set has one switch. Closure of the explicit candidates is equivalent to 3t>=k-3, yielding floor(2k/3) distinct extremizers. Independent semigroup enumeration confirms complete sets for all odd F=5,...,31; that experiment is not used as an infinite proof.
